170031 bolding-text-lesson.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Bolding Text Lesson</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lexend:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: full-screen word-processor simulation; lesson panel docked bottom-left with mascot, page centered. Single light look by design. */
:root{
  --chrome:#f9fbfd; --bar:#edf2fa; --page:#ffffff; --line:#dadce0; --ink:#1f1f1f; --icon:#444746; --muted:#5f6368;
  --accent:#1a73e8; --accent-soft:#e8f0fe; --ok:#188038; --ok-soft:#e6f4ea; --hl:#c6dafc; --sunk:#f3f6fb;
  --ui:"Lexend",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  --app:"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  color-scheme:light;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0}
html,body{height:100%}
body{background:var(--chrome);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--app);font-size:14px;overflow:hidden}
.app{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

/* title + menus */
.top{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 16px 4px}
.top .meta{min-width:0}
.title{font-size:18px;line-height:1.2;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px}
.menus{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap}
.menus span{padding:3px 7px;border-radius:4px;font-size:14px;cursor:default}
.menus span:hover{background:#e1e5ea}

/* toolbar */
.tbwrap{padding:4px 16px 6px}
.toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:var(--bar);border-radius:24px;padding:4px 10px;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.t{flex:none;height:28px;min-width:28px;padding:0 5px;border:0;border-radius:4px;background:transparent;color:var(--icon);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;font:13px var(--app);cursor:pointer}
.t:hover{background:#dfe3eb}
.t svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6}
.sep{flex:none;width:1px;height:20px;background:#c7c7c7;margin:0 6px}
.dd::after{content:"";border:4px solid transparent;border-top-color:currentColor;margin-top:4px}
.size{width:34px;height:24px;border:1px solid #747775;border-radius:4px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px}
.t.b{font-weight:700;font-size:15px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
.t.b.on{background:#d3e3fd;color:#041e49;box-shadow:none;animation:none}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent),0 0 0 7px rgba(26,115,232,0)}60%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--accent),0 0 0 5px rgba(26,115,232,.25)}}
.t:focus-visible,.btn:focus-visible,.how:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.spacer{flex:1 0 12px}
.editing{flex:none;display:inline-flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:13px}

/* canvas */
.canvas{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:16px 16px 40px;position:relative}
.paper{background:var(--page);width:816px;max-width:100%;min-height:1056px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid #e0e3e7;padding:72px 96px;font:15px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
#word{border-radius:2px}
#word.sel{background:var(--hl);box-shadow:none}
#word.bold{font-weight:700;box-shadow:none}

/* lesson panel */
.coach{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:24px;width:350px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px;font-family:var(--ui);z-index:5}
.card{position:relative;width:100%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--accent);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(26,115,232,.14),0 16px 40px rgba(26,60,120,.24),0 2px 6px rgba(32,48,80,.1);animation:enter .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) both}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-2px;border-radius:18px;pointer-events:none;animation:ring 1.4s ease-out .5s 3 both}
@keyframes ring{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(26,115,232,.55)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(26,115,232,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 22px rgba(26,115,232,0)}}
.coach.dragging .card::before{animation:none}
@keyframes enter{from{transform:translateY(16px) scale(.96);opacity:.4}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.card::after{content:"";position:absolute;bottom:-9px;left:160px;width:16px;height:16px;background:#fff;border-right:2px solid var(--accent);border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.c-band{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-radius:15px 15px 0 0;padding:14px 18px 16px}
.c-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.move{position:relative;flex:none;width:32px;height:32px;margin:-4px -6px -4px 0;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.move:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.26)}
.move:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fff;outline-offset:2px}
.move svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tip{position:absolute;bottom:calc(100% + 10px);right:-6px;white-space:nowrap;background:#1f1f1f;color:#fff;font:500 12px var(--ui);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px);transition:opacity .15s,transform .15s}
.tip::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:100%;right:16px;border:5px solid transparent;border-top-color:#1f1f1f}
.move:hover .tip,.move:focus-visible .tip{opacity:1;transform:none}
.coach.dragging .tip{opacity:0}
.coach.dragging,.coach.dragging .move{cursor:grabbing}
.coach.dragging .card{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(26,115,232,.14),0 24px 56px rgba(26,60,120,.32);animation:none}
body.no-select{user-select:none}
.c-task{font-size:22px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;color:#fff}
.dots{display:flex;gap:4px}.dots i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}.dots i.d{background:#fff}
.c-band h2{font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin:2px 0 6px;line-height:1.2}
.why{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:#e4edff}
.c-body{padding:16px 16px 12px}
.steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px}
.step{display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 1fr;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sunk);border:2px solid transparent;font-size:15px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted);transition:background .25s,border-color .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.n{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border:2px solid #cfd6e0;color:var(--muted);background:#fff}
.step.now{background:#fff;border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-size:16px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(26,115,232,.2)}
.card .steps .t{display:block;height:auto;min-width:0;padding:0;border-radius:0;background:none;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:14px;font-weight:300;cursor:default}
.card .steps .t b{font-weight:700}
.step.now .n{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.step.done{background:var(--ok-soft)}.step.done .n{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok);color:#fff}.step.done .t{text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:rgba(24,128,56,.5)}
.kbd{display:inline-block;font:600 11px var(--ui);padding:0 6px;border:1px solid #cfd6e0;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;vertical-align:1px}
.bchip{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:5px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cfd6e0;font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif;vertical-align:-3px}
.how{margin-top:10px;padding:4px 0;color:var(--accent);font:500 13px var(--ui);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.demo{margin-top:6px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--sunk);padding:10px 12px;font:14px Arial,sans-serif;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.demob{font:700 12px Arial,sans-serif;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #cfd6e0;background:#fff;animation:press 3s infinite}
.demo .w{position:relative;z-index:0;animation:bold 3s infinite}
.demo .w::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 -1px;background:var(--hl);border-radius:2px;z-index:-1;transform-origin:left;animation:sel 3s infinite}
@keyframes sel{0%,10%{transform:scaleX(0)}35%,70%{transform:scaleX(1)}80%,100%{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes bold{0%,55%{font-weight:400}60%,95%{font-weight:700}100%{font-weight:400}}
@keyframes press{0%,50%{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}55%,65%{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}70%,100%{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}}
.c-foot{padding:0 16px 14px}
.btn{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px;font:600 15px var(--ui);cursor:pointer;background:#eef1f5;color:#7a8291;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.btn.ready{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.win{background:var(--ok);color:#fff}
.success{margin:0 0 10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ok-soft);color:var(--ok);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;text-align:center}
.mascot{width:150px;margin-left:93px;margin-top:-8px}
.mascot img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.reset{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:6px 12px;font:13px var(--ui);color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;z-index:6}

@media (max-width:1100px){.paper{padding:56px 48px}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  body{overflow:auto}
  .app{height:auto;min-height:100%}
  .canvas{overflow:visible;padding-bottom:16px}
  .paper{min-height:280px;padding:32px 24px}
  .coach{position:static;width:auto;margin:0 16px 64px}
  .mascot{display:none}.card::after{display:none}.move{display:none}
  .menus span{font-size:13px;padding:2px 5px}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="app">
  <div class="top">
    <svg width="28" height="38" viewBox="0 0 28 38" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 0h15l10 10v25a3 3 0 0 1-3 3H3a3 3 0 0 1-3-3V3a3 3 0 0 1 3-3z" fill="#4c8bf5"/><path d="M18 0l10 10h-7a3 3 0 0 1-3-3z" fill="#a1c2fa"/><path d="M7 18h14M7 22h14M7 26h14M7 30h9" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"/></svg>
    <div class="meta">
      <div class="title">Bolding Text</div>
      <div class="menus"><span>File</span><span>Edit</span><span>View</span><span>Insert</span><span>Format</span><span>Tools</span><span>Extensions</span><span>Help</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="tbwrap">
    <div class="toolbar" role="toolbar" aria-label="Formatting">
      <button class="t" aria-label="Undo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 14L4 9l5-5M4 9h10a6 6 0 0 1 0 12h-3"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Redo"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15 14l5-5-5-5M20 9H10a6 6 0 0 0 0 12h3"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Print"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 9V3h10v6M6 18H4v-8h16v8h-2M7 14h10v7H7z"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Spelling"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 16l4-11 4 11M5.5 12h5M13 17l3 3 5-7"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Paint format"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 3h12v5H5zM17 5h2v6h-8v3M10 14h2v7h-2z"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t dd">100%</button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t dd">Normal text</button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t dd" style="min-width:110px;justify-content:space-between">Arial</button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Decrease font size">−</button>
      <span class="size">11</span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Increase font size">+</button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t b target" id="boldBtn" aria-label="Bold" aria-pressed="false">B</button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Italic" style="font:italic 15px Georgia,serif">I</button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Underline" style="text-decoration:underline;font-size:15px">U</button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Text color" style="font-weight:600;border-bottom:3px solid #1f1f1f;border-radius:0;height:22px">A</button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Highlight color"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M14 4l6 6-8 8H6v-6zM4 22h16" style="stroke:#1f1f1f"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Insert link"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 14a4 4 0 0 0 6 0l3-3a4 4 0 0 0-6-6l-1 1M14 10a4 4 0 0 0-6 0l-3 3a4 4 0 0 0 6 6l1-1"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Add comment"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4h16v12H8l-4 4zM12 7v6M9 10h6"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Insert image"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4h16v16H4zM4 16l5-5 5 5 2-2 4 4"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Align"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 6h16M4 10h10M4 14h16M4 18h10"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Line spacing"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 6h10M10 12h10M10 18h10M5 4v16M3 6l2-2 2 2M3 18l2 2 2-2"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Numbered list"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 6h10M10 12h10M10 18h10M4 5h1v3M4 11h2l-2 3h2"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Bulleted list"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M10 6h10M10 12h10M10 18h10M5 6h.01M5 12h.01M5 18h.01" stroke-width="2.4"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Decrease indent"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16M10 10h10M10 14h10M4 19h16M7 9l-3 3 3 3"/></svg></button>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Increase indent"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16M10 10h10M10 14h10M4 19h16M4 9l3 3-3 3"/></svg></button>
      <span class="sep"></span>
      <button class="t" aria-label="Clear formatting"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 5h12M12 5l-3 14M4 4l16 16"/></svg></button>
      <span class="spacer"></span>
      <span class="editing">✎ Editing ▾</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="canvas">
    <div class="paper"><span>I </span><span id="word" class="hint">really</span><span> like pizza</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

<aside class="coach" aria-label="Lesson">
  <div class="card" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="cardTitle">
    <div class="c-band">
      <div class="c-top"><span class="c-task" id="cardTitle">Your task</span>
        <button class="move" id="move" aria-label="Drag to reposition panel" aria-describedby="moveTip"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v18M3 12h18M12 3l-3 3M12 3l3 3M12 21l-3-3M12 21l3-3M3 12l3-3M3 12l3 3M21 12l-3-3M21 12l-3 3"/></svg><span class="tip" id="moveTip" role="tooltip">Drag to reposition panel</span></button>
      </div>
      <p class="why">You can bold a word or phrase to make it stand out. Bold text catches the eye and signals what is most important.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="c-body">
      <ol class="steps">
        <li class="step now" id="s1"><span class="n">1</span><span class="t">Select the word <b>really</b> in the document</span></li>
        <li class="step" id="s2"><span class="n">2</span><span class="t">Click the <b>Bold</b> button in the toolbar</span></li>
      </ol>
      <span class="how"><svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 10 10" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 1l4 4-4 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>Show me how</span>
    </div>
    <div class="c-foot">
      <p class="success" id="success" role="status" hidden>Well done! You've got this!</p>
      <button class="btn" id="check">Check my work</button>    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="mascot"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Blicko"></div>
</aside>

<button class="reset" id="reset">Reset task</button>

<script>
(function(){
  const word=document.getElementById('word'), boldBtn=document.getElementById('boldBtn'),
        s1=document.getElementById('s1'), s2=document.getElementById('s2'),
        check=document.getElementById('check'), success=document.getElementById('success');
  let selected=false, bolded=false;
  function render(){
    s1.className='step '+(selected||bolded?'done':'now');
    s2.className='step '+(bolded?'done':(selected?'now':''));
    s1.querySelector('.n').textContent=(selected||bolded)?'✓':'1';
    s2.querySelector('.n').textContent=bolded?'✓':'2';
    word.className=bolded?'bold':(selected?'sel':'hint');
    boldBtn.classList.toggle('target',!bolded);
    boldBtn.classList.toggle('on',bolded);
    boldBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',bolded);
    if(!check.classList.contains('win')) check.classList.toggle('ready',bolded);
  }
  function selectionIsWord(){
    const s=window.getSelection(); if(!s||s.isCollapsed) return false;
    return s.toString().trim().toLowerCase()==='really' && word.contains(s.anchorNode);
  }
  document.addEventListener('selectionchange',()=>{ if(bolded) return; const v=selectionIsWord(); if(v!==selected){selected=v;render();} });
  word.addEventListener('click',()=>{ if(bolded) return; const r=document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(word); const s=getSelection(); s.removeAllRanges(); s.addRange(r); });
  function applyBold(){
    if(bolded) return;
    if(!selected) return;
    bolded=true; getSelection().removeAllRanges(); render();
  }
  boldBtn.addEventListener('mousedown',e=>e.preventDefault());
  boldBtn.addEventListener('click',applyBold);
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{ if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key.toLowerCase()==='b'){e.preventDefault();applyBold();} });
  check.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(!bolded) return;
    check.classList.remove('ready'); check.classList.add('win'); check.textContent='Continue';
    success.hidden=false;
  });
  document.getElementById('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{
    selected=bolded=false; check.className='btn'; check.textContent='Check my work'; success.hidden=true; getSelection().removeAllRanges(); render();
  });
  render();

  // Drag the lesson panel by its move handle
  const coach=document.querySelector('.coach'), move=document.getElementById('move');
  let drag=null;
  function place(x,y){
    const r=coach.getBoundingClientRect();
    x=Math.min(Math.max(8,x),innerWidth-r.width-8);
    y=Math.min(Math.max(8,y),innerHeight-r.height-8);
    coach.style.left=x+'px'; coach.style.top=y+'px'; coach.style.bottom='auto';
  }
  move.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    const r=coach.getBoundingClientRect();
    drag={dx:e.clientX-r.left,dy:e.clientY-r.top};
    move.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    coach.classList.add('dragging'); document.body.classList.add('no-select');
    e.preventDefault();
  });
  move.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{ if(drag) place(e.clientX-drag.dx,e.clientY-drag.dy); });
  function endDrag(){ drag=null; coach.classList.remove('dragging'); document.body.classList.remove('no-select'); }
  move.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);
  move.addEventListener('pointercancel',endDrag);
  move.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
    const step=e.shiftKey?40:10, d={ArrowLeft:[-step,0],ArrowRight:[step,0],ArrowUp:[0,-step],ArrowDown:[0,step]}[e.key];
    if(!d) return; e.preventDefault();
    const r=coach.getBoundingClientRect(); place(r.left+d[0],r.top+d[1]);
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{ if(coach.style.top){ const r=coach.getBoundingClientRect(); place(r.left,r.top); } });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
